mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (current value) predicts positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days because it reduces the cost of capital and increases the present value of future equity cash flows.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5% over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 0.2 percentage points in one month signals economic weakness and predicts negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE rises > 0.2pp in 1 month over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) by more than 1% in the last month indicates a broad-based demand slowdown, predicting negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS decline by > 1% in the last month over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a stagflationary regime (CPIAUCSL > 230 and FEDFUNDS < 0.5%), a decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals an imminent economic contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO declines and the regime condition (CPIAUCSL>230 and FEDFUNDS<0.5%) is met over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A high level of housing starts (current value) indicates robust consumer demand and economic expansion, supporting positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when HOUST is above its 5-year average over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1.5% in one month signals a supply shock and predicts negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO falls > 1.5% in 1 month over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in payroll employment (PAYEMS) and decrease in unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates a robust labor market, supporting consumer spending and corporate earnings, which predicts positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when PAYEMS rises > 0.5% and UNRATE falls > 0.1pp in the last month over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a weak demand regime (UNRATE > 5.0 and HOUST < 900), a rise in retail sales (RSAFS) indicates a recovery in consumer spending, supporting positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when RSAFS rises and the regime condition (UNRATE>5.0 and HOUST<900) is met over a 3-year rolling window.
